Want an audio design with decor in mind? 

Then our Defunc HOME multi-room Wi-Fi speaker is for you. 

Featuring intelligent and powerful sound, every detail of HOME has been designed for seamless integration with the details of an authentic home environment. 

Created in collaboration with top Swedish audio engineer and acoustics expert Henrik Isaksson, the speaker's carefully calibrated components do justice to all musical genres and audio types. 

From heavy beats to chatty podcasts to delicate strings, you'll hear your tunes exactly as they were meant to be heard. 

No matter where you are in your home.

¿Quiere un diseño de audio pensando en la decoración? Entonces nuestro altavoz Wi-Fi multiroom Defunc HOME es para usted. Con un sonido inteligente y potente, cada detalle de HOME se ha diseñado para integrarse a la perfección con los detalles de un auténtico entorno doméstico. Creado en colaboración con el destacado ingeniero de audio y experto en acústica sueco Henrik Isaksson, los componentes cuidadosamente calibrados del altavoz hacen justicia a todos los géneros musicales y tipos de audio. Desde ritmos fuertes a podcasts parlanchines o cuerdas delicadas, escuchará sus canciones exactamente como deben escucharse. No importa en qué parte de la casa se encuentre.

Vous voulez une conception audio avec un dr à l'esprit? 
Alors notre enceinte Wi-Fi multi-room Defunc HOME est faite pour vous. 
Doté d'un son intelligent et puissant, chaque détail de HOME a été conçu pour une intégration fluide avec les détails d'un environnement domestique authentique. 
Créés en collaboration avec le meilleur ingénieur du son et expert en acoustique suédois Henrik Isaksson, les composants soigneusement calibrés de l'enceinte rendent justiceà tous les genres musicaux et types audio. 
Des rythmes lourds aux podcasts bavards en passant par les cordes délicates, vous uterez vos morceaux exactement comme ils étaient censés être entendus. 
Où que vous soyez dans votre maison.

Dotato di un suono intelligente e potente, ogni dettaglio di HOME è stato progettato per integrarsi perfettamente con i dettagli di un ambiente domestico autentico.
Creati in collaborazione con il famoso ingegnere del suono svedese ed esperto di acustica Henrik Isaksson, i componenti meticolosamente calibrati dello speaker rendono giustizia a tutti i generi musicali e tipi di audio.
Dai ritmi più intensi ai podcast più chiacchieroni, fino ai delicati archi, ascolterai la tua musica esattamente come è stata concepita.

long_description.data:
Defunc TRUE BASIC is a True Wireless earphone perfect for a sound experience thanks to its tactical control including volume intensity. It is suitable for long time listening (4h battery life).

TRUE BASIC features a unique MultiTip™️ design based on consumer feedback and studies.

It provides long-lasting comfort, a secure in-ear fit and is water and sweat resistant.

The included charging case provides up to 12 hours of talk time.

4h of autonomy in conversation

12 hours of total autonomy with the box

1.5 hour charging time Bluetooth 5.0 Wireless range of 10 m

Touch control including volume

IPX4 water and sweat resistant

Defunc TRUE BASIC es un auricular True Wireless perfecto para una experiencia de sonido gracias a su control táctico que incluye la intensidad del volumen. Es adecuado para escuchar durante mucho tiempo (duración de la batería de 4 h). TRUE BASIC presenta un diseño único MultiTip ™ ️ basado en los comentarios y estudios de los consumidores. Proporciona comodidad duradera, un ajuste seguro en la oreja y es resistente al agua y al sudor.El estuche de carga incluido proporciona hasta 12 horas de tiempo de conversación.- 4h de autonomía sin la caja de carga- 12 horas de autonomía total con la caja de carga- 1,5 horas de tiempo de carga- Bluetooth 5.0- Alcance inalámbrico de 10 m- Control táctil que incluye volumen- Resistente al agua y al sudor IPX4

Defunc TRUE BASIC est un uteur True Wireless parfait pour une expérience sonore grâce à son contrôle tactique incluant l'intensité du volume. Il convient à une ute de longue durée (4h d'autonomie). long_description.data:
MONDO by Defunc is the result of collaboration between Swedish audio experts and the Swedish music industry, under a new brand name: MONDO by Defunc.

It is the result of the association of three companies with extensive audio expertise, close links with the Scandinavian music industry, and direct contact with the artists and creators on the urban scene. Simply put, MONDO products sound like the artists want them to.

The design elements are clear reminders of this Scandinavian musical heritage.

From the design of the knobs, selectors and controllers on the products, inherited from mixing desks, to the unique signature of the packaging with its cut corner, a subtle reminder of the vinyl editions intended for DJs in the 80s.

Music is part of our DNA and guides us throughout the development process of our products, from the design sketch to collaborations with artists.

Here's our first product: MONDO on-ear headphones. You're going to love them.

RICHER SOUND THANKS TO DUAL DRIVERS

For more precise highs and more harmonious low frequencies when listening to your favourite music. The two drivers focus on the mid/bass and treble frequencies respectively, delivering a rich, balanced audio experience.

DESIGN ELEMENTS INSPIRED BY THE WORLD OF MUSIC

The knob (selector) and slider (fader) on the earpiece are used for volume controls and track switching, playing music and taking calls, they are all inspired by the technical elements of music production studios.

HIGH QUALITY AUDIO WITH APTX™ HD

The headphones, designed with high-quality dual drivers and aptX™ HD technology, give you high-definition audio. Now you can experience your favourite music like never before, without missing a beat - literally.

Use the downloadable app to make your own EQ settings and you're all set.

THREE FINISHES AVAILABLE

Our on-ear headphones have a timeless yet modern design and are available in three finishes: classic black, greige and clear for those who want to stand out from the crowd.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
Bluetooth version: 5.2
USB-C charging cable
Battery capacity: 620 mAh
Dual drivers: 40 mm and 10 mm

Dual microphone (dual microphone with ENC* function)

*Environmental Noise Cancelling = attenuation of ambient noise for the caller
Battery life: 45H
Talk time: 45H
Playback time: 45H

Charging time: 2H
Sensitivity: 102dBSPL at 1mW (0.179V), 1kHz
Frequency range: 20Hz - 20kHz
Dding: aptX HD

Google and iOS compatible Mondo by Defunc app for customising equaliser settings.

MONDO by Defunc est le fruit de la collaboration entre des experts audio suédois et l'industrie musicale suédoise, sous un nouveau nom de marque : MONDO by Defunc.

Elle est le résultat de l'association de trois sociétés ayant une grande expertise audio, des liens étroits avec l'industrie musicale scandinave, et en contact direct avec les artistes et créateurs de la scène urbaine. En termes simples, le son des produits MONDO est celui voulu par ses artistes.

Les éléments de design sont autant de rappels manifestes à cet héritage musical scandinave.

Du design des boutons, sélecteurs et contrôleurs des produits, hérités des tables de mixages, jusqu'à la signature unique du packaging avec son coin coupé, rappel subtil des éditions vinyles destinées aux DJs dans les années 80.

La musique fait partie de notre ADN et nous guide tout au long du processus de développement de nos produits, de l'ébauche du design aux collaborations avec les artistes.

Voici notre premier né : le casque supra-auriculaire MONDO. Vous allez l'adorer.

UN SON PLUS RICHE GR'CE AUX DOUBLES DRIVERS

Pour des aigus plus précis et des basses fréquences plus harmonieuses lors de l'ute de votre musique préférée. Les deux haut-parleurs se concentrent respectivement sur les médiums/basses et les aigus, ce qui permet de bénéficier d'une expérience audio riche et équilibrée

'L'MENTS DE DESIGN INSPIR'S DE L'UNIVERS MUSICAL

Le bouton (sélecteur) et le curseur (fader) situés sur l'uteur sont utilisés pour les réglages du volume et le changement de piste, la lecture de musique et la prise d'appels, ils sont tous inspirés des éléments techniques des studios de production de musique.

AUDIO HAUTE QUALIT' AVEC APTX' HD

Le casque, conçu avec des doubles haut-parleurs de haute qualité et la technologie aptX' HD, vous offre un son haute définition. Vous pouvez désormais vivre votre musique préférée comme jamais auparavant, sans en manquer un battement - littéralement.

Utilisez l'application téléchargeable pour faire vos propres réglages d'égalisation et tout est prêt.

TROIS FINITIONS DISPONIBLES

Nos casques supra-auriculaires affichent un design intemporel et moderne à la fois et sont disponibles en trois versions : noir classique, greige et transparente pour ceux qui veulent se démarquer.

SP'CIFICATIONS TECHNIQUES
Version Bluetooth : 5.2
Câble de chargement USB-C
Capacité de la batterie : 620 mAh
Double Drivers : 40 mm et 10 mm

Double microphone (double micro avec fonction ENC*)

*Environmental Noise Cancelling = atténuation du bruit environnant pour l'interlocuteur
Durée de la batterie : 45H
Durée en conversation : 45H
Durée de lecture : 45H

Temps de charge : 2H
Sensibilité : 102dBSPL à 1mW (0.179V), 1kHz
Gamme de fréquences : 20Hz - 20kHz
Ddage : aptX HD

Application Mondo by Defunc compatible Google et iOS pour la personnalisation des réglages de l'égaliseur.

MONDO by Defunc è il risultato della collaborazione tra esperti audio svedesi e l'industria musicale svedese, con un nuovo marchio: MONDO by Defunc.

È il prodotto di una partnership tra tre aziende con una vasta esperienza nel settore audio, stretti legami con l'industria musicale scandinava e un contatto diretto con artisti e creatori della scena musicale urbana. In poche parole, il suono dei prodotti MONDO è il suono concepito dai suoi artisti.

Gli elementi di design sono chiari richiami a questa tradizione musicale scandinava.

Dal design di pulsanti, selettori e controller, ispirato alle console di mixaggio, all'esclusiva firma del packaging con l'angolo tagliato, un sottile richiamo ai dischi in vinile per DJ degli anni '80.

La musica fa parte del nostro DNA e ci guida durante l'intero processo di sviluppo del prodotto, dal concept iniziale del design alle nostre collaborazioni con gli artisti.

Vi presentiamo la nostra prima creazione: le cuffie on-ear MONDO. Le adorerete.

SUONO PIÙ RICCO GRAZIE AI DOPPI DRIVER

Per alti più precisi e bassi più armoniosi durante l'ascolto della tua musica preferita. I due driver si concentrano rispettivamente sui medi/bassi e sugli alti, per un'esperienza audio ricca e bilanciata.

DESIGN ISPIRATO AL MONDO DELLA MUSICA

Il pulsante (selettore) e il cursore (fader) sulle cuffie servono per il controllo del volume, il cambio traccia, la riproduzione musicale e la risposta alle chiamate. Sono tutti ispirati agli elementi tecnici presenti negli studi di produzione musicale.

AUDIO DI ALTA QUALITÀ CON APTX HD

Progettate con doppi driver di alta qualità e tecnologia aptX HD, queste cuffie offrono un suono ad alta definizione. Ora puoi ascoltare la tua musica preferita come mai prima d'ora, senza perdere un colpo, letteralmente.

Usa l'app scaricabile per personalizzare le impostazioni dell'equalizzatore e sei pronto.

TRE FINITURE DISPONIBILI

Le nostre cuffie on-ear presentano un design senza tempo ma moderno e sono disponibili in tre versioni: nero classico, greige e trasparente per chi vuole distinguersi.

SPECIFICHE TECNICHE
Versione Bluetooth: 5.2
Cavo di ricarica USB-C
Capacità della batteria: 620 mAh
Doppio driver: 40 mm e 10 mm

Doppio microfono (doppio microfono con funzione ENC*)

*Cancellazione del rumore ambientale = attenuazione del rumore ambientale per la persona all'altro capo della chiamata
Durata della batteria: 45 ore
Tempo di conversazione: 45 ore
Tempo di riproduzione: 45 ore

Tempo di ricarica: 2 ore
Sensibilità: 102 dB SPL a 1 mW (0,179 V), 1 kHz
Gamma di frequenza: 20 Hz - 20 kHz
Audio: aptX HD

App Mondo by Defunc compatibile con Google e iOS per personalizzare le impostazioni dell'equalizzatore.

long_description.data:
MONDO by Defunc is the result of collaboration between Swedish audio experts and the Swedish music industry, under a new brand name: MONDO by Defunc.

It is the result of the association of three companies with extensive audio expertise, close links with the Scandinavian music industry, and direct contact with the artists and creators on the urban scene. Simply put, MONDO products sound like the artists want them to.

The design elements are clear reminders of this Scandinavian musical heritage.

From the design of the knobs, selectors and controllers on the products, inherited from mixing desks, to the unique signature of the packaging with its cut corner, a subtle reminder of the vinyl editions intended for DJs in the 80s.

Music is part of our DNA and guides us throughout the development process of our products, from the design sketch to collaborations with artists.

Here's our first product: MONDO on-ear headphones. You're going to love them.

RICHER SOUND THANKS TO DUAL DRIVERS

For more precise highs and more harmonious low frequencies when listening to your favourite music. The two drivers focus on the mid/bass and treble frequencies respectively, delivering a rich, balanced audio experience.

DESIGN ELEMENTS INSPIRED BY THE WORLD OF MUSIC

The knob (selector) and slider (fader) on the earpiece are used for volume controls and track switching, playing music and taking calls, they are all inspired by the technical elements of music production studios.

HIGH QUALITY AUDIO WITH APTX™ HD

The headphones, designed with high-quality dual drivers and aptX™ HD technology, give you high-definition audio. Now you can experience your favourite music like never before, without missing a beat - literally.

Use the downloadable app to make your own EQ settings and you're all set.

THREE FINISHES AVAILABLE

Our on-ear headphones have a timeless yet modern design and are available in three finishes: classic black, greige and clear for those who want to stand out from the crowd.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
Bluetooth version: 5.2
USB-C charging cable
Battery capacity: 620 mAh
Dual drivers: 40 mm and 10 mm

Dual microphone (dual microphone with ENC* function)

*Environmental Noise Cancelling = attenuation of ambient noise for the caller
Battery life: 45H
Talk time: 45H
Playback time: 45H

Charging time: 2H
Sensitivity: 102dBSPL at 1mW (0.179V), 1kHz
Frequency range: 20Hz - 20kHz
Dding: aptX HD

long_description.data: MONDO by Defunc is the result of the collaboration between Swedish audio experts and the Swedish music industry, under a new brand name: MONDO by Defunc. It is the result of the association of three companies with extensive audio expertise, close ties to the Scandinavian music industry, and direct contact with artists and creators on the urban scene. Simply put, MONDO products sound as the artists intended it to. The design elements are clear reminders of this Scandinavian musical heritage. From the design of the products' buttons, selectors and controllers, inherited from mixing desks, to the unique signature packaging with its cut corner, a subtle reminder of the vinyl editions intended for DJs in the 80s. Music is part of our DNA and guides us through the entire product development process, from design sketches to collaborations with artists. Introducing our first product: MONDO on-ear headphones. You're going to love them. RICHER SOUND THANKS TO DUAL DRIVERSFor more precise highs and more harmonious low frequencies when listening to your favorite music. The two drivers focus on mid/bass and treble respectively, for a rich, balanced audio experience.DESIGN ELEMENTS INSPIRED BY THE WORLD OF MUSICThe button (selector) and slider (fader) on the headphones are used for volume controls and track switching, playing music and taking calls, all inspired by the technical elements of music production studios.HIGH-QUALITY AUDIO WITH APTX™ HDThe headphones, designed with high-quality dual drivers and aptX™ HD technology, give you high-definition sound. È il prodotto di una partnership tra tre aziende con una vasta esperienza nel settore audio, stretti legami con l'industria musicale scandinava e un contatto diretto con artisti e creatori della scena musicale urbana. In poche parole, il suono dei prodotti MONDO è il suono concepito dai suoi artisti.

Gli elementi di design sono chiari richiami a questa tradizione musicale scandinava.

Dal design di pulsanti, selettori e controller, ispirato alle console di mixaggio, all'esclusiva firma del packaging con l'angolo tagliato, un sottile richiamo ai dischi in vinile per DJ degli anni '80.

La musica è parte del nostro DNA e ci guida durante l'intero processo di sviluppo del prodotto, dal concept iniziale del design alle nostre collaborazioni con gli artisti.

Ecco la nostra prima creazione: le cuffie on-ear MONDO. Le adorerai.

Per alti più precisi e bassi più armoniosi durante l'ascolto della tua musica preferita. I due altoparlanti si concentrano rispettivamente sulle frequenze medio-basse e alte, per un'esperienza audio ricca e bilanciata.

long_description.data: The Moon Lamp is an outdoor lamp with a moon-inspired design, created to accompany your evenings outdoors. It diffuses a soft, warm light with several color modes to create the perfect atmosphere, whether for dinner on the terrace, an evening with friends, or a moment of relaxation under the stars. Elegant and practical, it enhances your outdoor moments.

Emite una luz suave y cálida con varios modos de color para crear el ambiente perfecto, ya sea para una cena en la terraza, una velada con amigos o un momento de relax bajo las estrellas. Elegante y práctica, realza tus momentos al aire libre.

Elle diffuse une lumière douce et chaleureuse avec plusieurs modes couleur pour créer l’ambiance parfaite, que ce soit pour un dîner sur la terrasse, une soirée entre amis ou un moment de détente sous les étoiles. Élégante et pratique, elle sublime vos instants en plein air.

La Moon Lamp è una lampada da esterno dal design ispirato alla luna, pensata per accompagnare le vostre serate all'aperto. Diffonde una luce morbida e calda con diverse modalità di colore per creare l'atmosfera perfetta, che si tratti di una cena in terrazza, una serata tra amici o un momento di relax sotto le stelle. Elegante e pratica, sublima i vostri momenti all'aria aperta.

The Xoopar 2.0 smart speaker made of recycled plastic ! 
Take a musical break wherever you are and surprise those around you with the NFC feature. A true digital communication tool, it allows you to share the desired information in a targeted, efficient and modern way. No need for an app, just scan the product to discover the information you want to share.

Autonomy of 8 hours 
NFC Function
Power:  10 Watts
2 charging modes: Wireless (IQ) / Wired (USB-C, lightning)

Emoji stickers, allowing you to customize your product according to your moods included!
2 years warranty

20% of the total volume of the product is made of recycled plastic

Marking :
Made in France

Tampo 1 and/or 2 colors
Possibility of double-sided/reverse marking

short_description.data: OCTO MINI - Câble de charge - Blanc

long_description.data: Made from recycled plastic, this cable provides a simple and stylish connection for all your devices thanks to its Lightning and USB-C connectors. Lightweight and ultra-convenient, it slips easily into a pocket so you can take it with you wherever you go. Available in several trendy colors, including the new lilac, the Octomini proves that a small size can make a big difference.

Este cable, fabricado con plástico reciclado, ofrece una conexión sencilla y elegante para todos tus dispositivos gracias a sus conectores Lightning y USB-C. Ligero y muy práctico, cabe fácilmente en un bolsillo para que te acompañe a todas partes. Disponible en varios colores de moda, entre ellos el nuevo y vibrante lila, el Octomini demuestra que un tamaño reducido puede marcar la diferencia

Ce câble conçu à partir de plastique recyclé, offre une connexion simple et élégante pour tous vos appareils grâce à ses connecteurs Lightning, USB-C. Léger et ultra-pratique, il se glisse facilement dans une poche pour vous accompagner partout. Disponible en plusieurs couleurs tendances, dont le nouveau lilas vibrant, l’Octomini démontre qu’un format réduit peut faire toute la différence.

Questo cavo, realizzato in plastica riciclata, offre una connessione semplice ed elegante per tutti i tuoi dispositivi grazie ai connettori Lightning e USB-C. Leggero e ultra pratico, si infila facilmente in tasca per seguirti ovunque. Disponibile in diversi colori di tendenza, tra cui il nuovo e vivace lilla, Octomini dimostra che le dimensioni ridotte possono fare la differenza.

digital_print_description.data: A modern process that prints the logo directly onto the object using a specialized printer, for four-color logos with inkjet printing and UV drying.
Procédé moderne qui imprime directement le logo sur l’objet via une imprimante spécialisée, pour les logos quadri avec un jet d’encre et séchage UV.

screen_print_description.data: Printing technique using a stencil (screen) to transfer ink onto the substrate.
Technique d’impression utilisant un pochoir (écran) pour faire passer l’encre sur le support.

pad_print_description.data: Printing technique that uses a silicone pad to transfer ink onto the object.
Technique d’impression indirecte qui utilise un tampon en silicone pour transférer l’encre sur l’objet.

laser_engraving_description.data: A precision method that lightly burns the surface of the material with a laser beam. The result is durable, unalterable, and elegant.
Méthode de marquage de précision qui brûle légèrement la surface du matériau avec un faisceau laser. Résultat durable, inaltérable et élégant.

Its slightly raised edges allow you to safely store keys, watches, coins or small objects. Easy to place on a console, desk or bedside table.

long_description.data: With its unique luggage-shaped design, Luggie is the universal adapter that combines practicality and wanderlust. Compact and robust, it can be used in over 150 countries thanks to its integrated EU, UK, US, and AUS plugs. Equipped with two 25W USB-C ports (which enable fast charging) and a 15W USB-A port, it allows you to charge multiple devices simultaneously. Its push-button system makes changing plugs simple and seamless. Luggie is the smart accessory that goes everywhere with you and ensures you stay connected, from city breaks to round-the-world trips.

Con su diseño único con forma de maleta, Luggie es el adaptador universal que combina practicidad y espíritu viajero. Compacto y resistente, se puede utilizar en más de 150 países gracias a sus enchufes integrados de tipo UE, Reino Unido, EE. UU. y Australia. Equipado con dos puertos USB-C de 25 W (que permiten la carga rápida) y un puerto USB-A de 15 W, permite cargar varios dispositivos a la vez. Su sistema de botón pulsador hace que cambiar de enchufe sea sencillo y fluido. Luggie es el accesorio inteligente que te acompaña a todas partes y te garantiza que estarás conectado, tanto en una escapada urbana como en una vuelta al mundo.

Avec son design unique en forme de bagage, Luggie est l’adaptateur universel qui allie praticité et esprit voyage. Compact et robuste, il s’utilise dans plus de 150 pays grâce à ses prises EU, UK, US et AUS intégrées. Équipé de deux ports USB-C 25W (qui permettent la charge rapide) et d’un port USB-A 15W, il permet de charger plusieurs appareils en simultané. Son système à bouton poussoir rend le changement de prise simple et fluide. Luggie, c’est l’accessoire malin qui vous suit partout et qui vous assure de rester connecté, du city break au tour du monde.

Con il suo esclusivo design simile a quello di un bagaglio, Luggie è l'adattatore universale che unisce praticità e spirito di viaggio. Compatto e robusto, può essere utilizzato in oltre 150 paesi grazie alle prese integrate UE, Regno Unito, Stati Uniti e Australia. Dotato di due porte USB-C da 25 W (per la ricarica rapida) e una porta USB-A da 15 W, consente di caricare più dispositivi contemporaneamente. Il suo sistema a pulsante semplifica e semplifica la sostituzione delle prese. Luggie è l'accessorio intelligente che ti accompagna ovunque e ti garantisce la massima connettività, dalle brevi vacanze in città ai viaggi intorno al mondo.
